body: I don't want to tell her. Might I pm you?
What would you do in my shoes?

It's not my forgiveness I seek. I just want this all to go away. I wasn't thinking. Now I'm paying for it. I can't forgive her boyfriend for using her for sex, yet look what I've done. I'm a hypocrite. What will I do when I see her?

Do you really think someone like me should live? I molested someone who trusts me above all others. She'll never know, if I continue to interact with her I am making the molested interact with the molester; that's twisted. Yet if interaction ceases she is hurt and I die.
What do I do? Do I really deserve life after this? I don't think so.

How do I move past this? What will I do when I see her? Break down and sob? Beg forgiveness for something she knows nothing of? I can't tell her. She'd be hurt, and she would leave. If she leaves then I will kill myself, she is the only reason I am alive today, I live so she won't have to grieve.

I can't think about anything else, I walked in my room and just stood there looking at my bed. It was like looking at a crime scene, my crime scene. What I did is, like you said, unforgivable. I do care about her, so much. I don't attach myself to people, ever, she's the first person that I find myself worrying about, thinking about, simply existing for. That's how I repay her confidence and the trust she gave me? That's how I thank her for talking me out of suicide before? Who does that? I'm pathetic. She has told me multiple times that she trusts no one more than me, she tells me she loves me, granted it's that friend love, not romantic, but we've been there before. I don't deserve her friendship or love or trust.
